summary_1line: King Dasharatha refuses to send young Rama with Vishwamitra, fearing the powerful rakshasas Maricha and Suvahu and expressing deep paternal attachment.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasharatha collapses unconscious from his throne as the court watches after hearing Vishwamitra request Rama.
The aged King Dasharatha pleads before the stern sage Vishwamitra in a royal court, refusing to send his young son Rama to face demons.
Sage Vishwamitra stands blazing with anger like fire in the royal hall as Dasharatha’s words inflame his wrath.
